definitions.gloss: family-friendly boss; manager who supports staff work-life balance
definitions.explanation: A manager who actively backs subordinates' childcare and family life — approving leave, cutting overtime, adjusting workloads — while still delivering results. A coined term promoted in workplace-reform campaigns since the mid-2010s.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧イクボス⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: She is well known as a family-friendly manager.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧イクボス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The company is putting effort into developing family-friendly managers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{育児休業|いくじきゅうぎょう}→育児休業：25440_ikujikyuugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}→当たり前：01685_atarimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦いわゆる→いわゆる：01840_iwayuru⟧イクボスだ。
examples.english: A boss who treats a subordinate's parental leave as a matter of course is what is called an ikubosu.

notes:
Coined from {育|いく} (of ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧, childcare) + English "boss", on the model of ⟦イクメン→イクメン：06723_ikumen⟧ (a father actively involved in childcare). Companies and local governments run イクボス⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧ campaigns in which managers publicly commit to the role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- イクボス⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧: a public pledge to be a family-friendly manager
- イクボス⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧: training for family-friendly managers
- イクボス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim to be a family-friendly manager

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦イクメン→イクメン：06723_ikumen⟧: a hands-on father — about a man's own parenting, not his management of others
- ⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}→働き方改革：23313_hatarakikatakaikaku⟧: workplace reform — the wider policy movement the term belongs to
